mn59:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn59:1.3: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati yen' āyasmā Udāyi ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ etad-avoca:
mn59:1.4: Kati nu kho bhante Udāyi vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ti. --
mn59:1.5: Tisso kho gahapati vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā:
mn59:1.6: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn59:1.7: Imā kho gahapati tisso vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ti. --
mn59:1.9: Na kho bhante Udāyi tisso vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā,
mn59:1.12: Yā 'yaṃ bhante adukkhamasukhā vedanā, santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā Bhagavatā ti.

mn59:4.1: Assosi kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmato Udāyissa Pañcakaṅgena thapatinā saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.

mn59:4.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando yāvatako ahosi āyasmato Udāyissa Pañcakaṅgena thapatinā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi.

mn59:8.4: Katamañ-c' Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañ-ca paṇītatarañ-ca:
mn59:8.5: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

mn59:9.4: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañ-ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yan-taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:9.5: Idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañ-ca paṇītatarañ-ca.
mn59:10.4: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:10.5: Idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañ-ca paṇītatarañ-ca.
mn59:11.4: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā: ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:11.5: Idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañ-ca paṇītatarañ-ca.
mn59:12.4: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma: anantaṃ viññāṇan-ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:12.5: Idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañ-ca.
mn59:13.4: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma: na-tthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn59:13.5: Idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañ-ca paṇītatarañ-ca.
mn59:14.4: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.

mn59:16.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Ānanda vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
mn59:16.2: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samaṇo Gotamo āha tañ-ca sukhasmiṃ paññāpeti,
mn59:16.3: ta-y-idaṃ kiṃ su, ta-y-idaṃ kathaṃ sūti.
mn59:16.4: Evaṃvādino Ānanda aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam-assu vacanīyā:
mn59:16.5: Na kho āvuso Bhagavā sukhaṃ yeva vedanaṃ sandhāya sukhasmiṃ paññāpeti,
mn59:16.6: api c' āvuso yattha yattha sukhaṃ upalabbhati yahiṃ yahiṃ tantaṃ Tathāgato sukhasmiṃ paññāpetīti.
mn59:16.8: Attamano āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 60.
